text:
alex_dev: Heads-up — we're kicking off a v1 deprecation plan next week, want platform + console + SRE alignment.
mei_plat: Quick Q: how are we handling live routing? soft-redirect? header-based fallback? :thinking_face:
alex_dev: Proposal: default route -> v2. If client sets `X-Api-Version: v1` we continue honoring for a 90d grace window, but emit a `compat=v1` telemetry tag. After 90d, fallthrough -> v2 and surface migration guidance.
sam_oncall: Concern: switching a large % to v2 could spike quotas/costs and change latency profile. Need capacity checks + circuit-breaker behavior for rollback.
chris_sre: From SRE side: consider a rule: if p99 latency > 500ms or error-rate increase > 2x for 5m, trigger auto-failover to legacy variant and page. Also add sampling logs for debugging.
lina_product: Console UX: show per-api-key "compatibility flag" with a toggle and countdown bar. Also show in-console banner for keys still sending v1 header. :warning:
mei_plat: Telemetry details: add `compat_version` (v1/v2), `deprecation_notice_seen` boolean, and `mirror_diff` sampling tag. Important: ensure we don't double-count quota when mirroring.
alex_dev: Quota question — do we keep v1 usage in the same quota bucket? My vote: yes (same bucket) but surface it as "legacy usage" in the console so customers can't game separate buckets.
sam_oncall: If same bucket, must expose "legacy usage" breakdown in billing exports and console charts. ops needs that to forecast commit changes.
chris_sre: Implementation sketch for router: add rule ordering, something like: `if header == v1 and now < grace_until -> route:v1_model emit:compat=v1` else `route:v2_model`. Wrap behind a feature flag so we can toggle behavior per-org.
alex_dev: Example router record we can use in the config: ```json
{ "match": {"header": "X-Api-Version", "value": "v1"}, "action": "route_v1", "emit": "compat=v1" }
``` Ping @deploy-bot to schedule a low-risk canary.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled a canary: 5% traffic in us-west on 2026-03-24T10:00Z. Will emit analytics hooks and create a canary run id.
lina_product: Messaging plan: in-console banner + email to API owners + SDK deprecation warning (minor log message) and docs migration guide with example diffs. Keep wording short and actionable.
mei_plat: Also recommend a mirror probe: for 1% of v1 requests, mirror to v2 and compute diffs (hash outputs + token-level diffs) to flag quality regressions automatically.
alex_dev: Good call. Hook Optimize/evals so product prompt sets are automatically compared. I'll draft a runbook for a fallback loop (if route -> v2 causes spikes and then we fallback repeatedly).
sam_oncall: I'll own alerts/SLO thresholds and oncall rotations for this window. Please add playbook steps + contact list.
chris_sre: I'll add dashboards: compat usage over time, mirror-diff rate, route failures, and heatmap by region. Opening infra PR after this thread.
alex_dev: Thanks — sync up Thurs 09:30 PT to finalize flags, console copy, and telemetry schema.
